connections.how: With the blue sofa on your left and the row of windows with dark curtains on your right, walk forward and turn left past the large bed with white bedding to reach the right turquoise nightstand.

Turn around and walk past the large bed with white bedding and the blue sofa on your right, with the row of windows with dark curtains and the photo grid wall on your left, to reach the left turquoise nightstand.
With the left turquoise nightstand on your right and the photo grid wall and shelving area doorway on your left, walk straight ahead to the landing doorway.
From the landing doorway, step into the tiled space where the long white vanity is on your right and the glass shower enclosure is ahead.
Turn around with the long white vanity on your left and walk forward to the landing doorway.
Pass through the landing doorway and walk forward with the wooden stair railing on your left and the blue exercise ball on your right toward the triple window with exercise gear.

Turn away from the triple window with exercise gear and the leaning yellow board, walk past the wooden stair railing on your right, and go halfway down the stairs to the wainscoted stairwell wall under the wall sconces.
Turn around at the wainscoted stairwell wall and walk up the stairs with the blue exercise ball on your left at the top, turning right to the landing doorway.
Step through the landing doorway toward the left turquoise nightstand on your left and turn immediately right to the shelving area doorway.
Step through the shelving area doorway into the narrow aisle with built-in white shelving and drawers and hanging clothes on both sides.
Turn around between the built-in white shelving and drawers and walk forward with hanging clothes on your right back to the shelving area doorway.

connections.to: row of windows with dark curtains
connections.how: Step out through the shelving area doorway and turn left, with the large bed with white bedding and blue sofa on your left and the photo grid wall and gray armchair on your right, facing the row of windows with dark curtains.

walk_summary: Start between the blue sofa on the left and the row of windows with dark curtains on the right, walking forward and turning left past the large bed with white bedding and flower painting to the right turquoise nightstand.

Turn around and walk past the row of windows with dark curtains and blue sofa, continuing between the photo grid wall on the left and the left turquoise nightstand on the right past the shelving area doorway to the landing doorway.
Enter the tiled area with the long white vanity on the right and glass shower enclosure ahead, then turn around and exit through the landing doorway.
Walk forward past the wooden stair railing on the left and the blue exercise ball on the right toward the triple window with exercise gear and leaning yellow board.

Turn around in the area near the blue exercise ball and triple window with exercise gear, then walk past the wooden stair railing and go halfway down the stairs to the wainscoted stairwell wall and wall sconces.
Turn around on the stairs, walk back up past the blue exercise ball on the left, and go through the landing doorway.
Turn right through the shelving area doorway into the narrow space with built-in white shelving and drawers and hanging clothes on both sides.

Turn around to walk back to the shelving area doorway, briefly pivot to look back at the built-in white shelving and drawers, then step out and turn left to face the row of windows with dark curtains and gray armchair.
Turn left in place to face the large bed with white bedding, flower painting, and left turquoise nightstand, with the shelving area doorway and landing doorway on the left.
